name: @w6w-apps/klicktipp
description: Manage KlickTipp contacts, tags, data fields and opt-in processes, and sign contacts in through a Listbuilding API key.

w6w.longDescription:
KlickTipp is a German email-marketing and marketing-automation platform. This app covers its documented Management API — adding, updating, searching, tagging, untagging, unsubscribing and deleting contacts, reading them singly, in bulk or as a changed-since feed, managing tags, listing data fields and opt-in processes — and its Listbuilding API for signing a contact in, out or off through a Listbuilding API key.

A connection is either an API user's username and password (Management actions) or a Listbuilding API key (the three Listbuilding actions). API access needs a KlickTipp Premium plan or higher.
